composition_label: Web research -> Interest-based recommendations -> Document review -> Semantic search

construction.implementation_origin: Written from scratch within the isolated build directory

shared_schema.request: schema_version, synthetic=true, allowlisted_hosts, sources, fixture_pages, preferences, requirements, search
shared_schema.envelope: schema_version, synthetic, status, stage, request, sources, findings, recommendations, reviews, search
shared_schema.validation: One shared validate entrypoint enforces request shape and types, URL allowlist, source identity and SHA-256 provenance, grounded recommendation evidence, review coverage, index linkage, ranking order, numeric bounds and stage order.

error_output.error: Human-readable validation or file error; CLI exits 2

cross_stage_handoffs.data: Validated source text and findings with source IDs, URLs, SHA-256 and exact character spans
Validated ranked, exclusion-filtered product recommendations and grounded finding references
Validated per-product requirement checks and gap counts; searchable documents are created only for reviewed recommendations

behavior.research: Exact-host HTTPS allowlist; default retrieval from synthetic fixture_pages; optional retriever(url)->str injection. No built-in network client or redirect handling.
behavior.recommendations: Score counts interests whose words occur together in a cited source. Case-insensitive tag exclusion and exact product-ID exclusion happen before ranking. Ties use product ID. Zero-score candidates remain eligible.
behavior.review: Each applicable requirement needs all keyword phrases in one source. Findings record checked sources, matched evidence, missing keywords and traceable gaps. Tag-specific requirements can be not_applicable. No certification claims.
behavior.semantic: In-memory inverted token index with cosine bag-of-words ranking by default. Optional embedder(text)->finite numeric sequence enables injected vector ranking. Zero or negative similarity is omitted. Source text, not unmet requirement descriptions, is indexed. Hits preserve review state and finding IDs.
behavior.injections: Python callable interfaces are tested with deterministic synthetic fixtures only. No LLM or provider is necessary.
behavior.determinism: Stable source order, stable product-ID tie breaking, no clock, random state, generated IDs or live requests. Injected callables are responsible for deterministic results.
behavior.provenance_retention: All retrieved sources remain in the research ledger, including excluded products; exclusions apply to recommendations, reviews, search documents, index and hits.

included: Single integrated CLI and Python API

cli.stdout: One valid JSON object with status ok and stage semantic

coverage: CLI success, missing file, malformed JSON, duplicate keys and validation errors
